Privacy policy

搭慕 · 담우 · Damu

Pre-launch draft: based on current code and operator information. Retention enforcement, overseas processing disclosures and final erasure remain pending. Effective date to be confirmed.

1. Operator and contact

Damu / 搭慕 / 담우 is operated by an individual, 金成龙 (JIN CHENGLONG). Privacy contact: JIN CHENGLONG, damumuapp@gmail.com. No public telephone is offered; private address and telephone are not published. The service is for adults aged 18 and over. Identity verification is not currently provided.

2. Account and profile

The current implementation registers users with email, password and nickname. Passwords use salted PBKDF2 hashes. Nickname is required; avatar, biography, city/district, languages, interests, gender, occupation, arrival year and voluntarily supplied contact details are optional where available. Phone and Google sign-in are planned, not implemented collection channels.

3. Content and messages

We process activity details, schedules, applications, membership status, meeting points and covers, plus direct/group messages, images, timestamps, read status, edits, recalls and report context. Features such as comments will be disclosed when enabled. Profiles and posts appear within their chosen audience; conversation members can see and independently copy messages.

4. Location and permissions

Device coordinates used for nearby results and distance may be precise; a medium-accuracy setting does not guarantee approximate-only collection. Current location calls occur in foreground features, with no background tracking found. You can decline permission and choose a region. Coordinates are sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim for place names. The latest device cache is no longer used after 30 minutes, but expiry does not physically erase it. No year-long GPS history database was found. Camera, photo and notification access are requested for the relevant features; contacts and microphone are not required for MVP1 safety tools.

5. Push and logs

Firebase Cloud Messaging processes registration tokens, Firebase installation identifiers and platform information; iOS delivery uses Apple APNs. Notification titles, bodies and related activity/conversation IDs may be sent to providers. Servers process request IPs, access records, login times and operational errors. No advertising identifier, Firebase Analytics or Crashlytics integration was found. Operational logging is not equivalent to comprehensive behavior tracking.

6. Reports, blocks and future safety tools

Reports may include party identifiers, reasons, descriptions, message snapshots, existing image evidence, times and outcomes. Block relationships are server-side. Complete evidence-upload and blocking interfaces require release verification. Safety meetups, emergency contacts and SOS are future features, not MVP1 collection purposes. Their permissions, recipients and retention will be disclosed before activation.

7. Purposes and basis

Data supports authentication, profiles, activity discovery/applications, communication, notifications, support and abuse prevention. The applicable basis depends on necessity for service, consent or a lawful exception. Optional permissions and marketing consent are separate. MVP1 has no advertisements, marketing broadcasts, payments or advertising profiles. User-selected regional and interest filters are not advertising profiling.

8. Proposed retention — enforcement pending

Account/profile/avatar: until deletion is processed, with a target of 1–2 business days. Public posts: remove on deletion, with necessary shared/disputed records handled under restricted access. Messages and chat images: one year from sending, retained for other members; unlink profile information on deletion. Message text may still identify people and is not fully anonymous. Reports/penalties: necessary evidence for one year from closure or penalty expiry. Routine diagnostic/access logs: suggested 90 days; necessary security audit records up to one year. Push tokens: remove when invalid or account deleted. Support: one year from closure. Backups: suggested rolling 30 days, replaying deletions after restoration. These are proposals, not verified automated cleanup. Legal exceptions require a documented basis, scope and end date.

9. Providers and international processing

The operator identifies AWS Lightsail in Korea as the main host, with self-managed PostgreSQL and uploaded files; S3 is not yet used. Google Firebase/FCM, Apple APNs for iOS, OpenStreetMap Foundation Nominatim and Gmail support mail are also used. Processing is therefore not guaranteed to remain in Korea. Firebase states that services without location selection may process data wherever Google or its agents have facilities. Exact contracting entities, countries, contacts, transfer timing/methods, retention and the applicable Korean transfer basis remain to be verified. Manual region selection avoids location lookup; disabling notifications does not necessarily erase existing installation identifiers. Rights requests can be made by email.

10. Rights and deletion

You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or withdrawal of consent. In the App: My → Settings → Account management → Delete account. Re-enter registered email and password; confirmation disables the account and signs you out. The operator targets subsequent processing within 1–2 business days. For email requests, use the registered mailbox; control of the account must be verified using only necessary information. Merely typing someone else’s email is insufficient. Never email passwords, codes or identity documents. Uninstalling does not delete your account.

11. Safeguards and erasure

Implemented measures include salted password hashing, signed login tokens, access checks and restricted exact meeting points. Production HTTPS, disk/backup encryption, recovery, personnel procedures and incident response require operational verification. Chats are not end-to-end encrypted. Fields called ciphertext in preliminary safety APIs currently use byte encoding, which is not encryption. Database and file erasure plus backup handling must be implemented for the agreed deletion rules.

12. Changes and effective date

Material changes will be announced in the App or website, with additional consent where required. Effective date: [TO BE CONFIRMED]. Policy, store privacy labels and actual behavior must be reconciled before release.
